PLAN "12-Week Couch-to-5K Plan"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve aerobic capacity and run performance for a 5K in 12 weeks"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Intro to run-walk"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          jog_in_place 2 minutes
          leg_circles 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x60 seconds rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          walk 90 seconds
          jog 1x60 seconds rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          walk 2 minutes
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Technique and easy pace"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          cat_cow 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x60 seconds rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Progression"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          hip_mretains? 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          jog 3x60 seconds rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Increasing intervals"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          jogging in place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x90 seconds rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          walk 2 minutes
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Steady cadence"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          leg swings 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          jog 4x60 seconds rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 50m "Threshold feel"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          dynamic leg 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          jog 3x90 seconds rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Longer runs"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          hip_opener 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x6 minutes rpe 5 rest 2 minutes
          jog 1x4 minutes rpe 5 rest 2 minutes
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Intervals mix"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          leg_circles 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          jog 6x60 seconds rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 55m "Cadence and form"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          ankle circles 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          jog 4x90 seconds rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Final prep"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          mobility sequence 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 5x3 minutes rpe 6 rest 2 minutes
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Taper and race readiness"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          light dynamic warmup 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x5 minutes rpe 6 rest 2 minutes
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Race week prep"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          mobility flow 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x5 minutes rpe 5 rest 2 minutes
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots, not a dash. Correct: `3x8..12`. Wrong: `3x8-12` or `3x8-10`.
- Sets always come first: `3x10` means 3 sets of 10 reps.
- RPE goes after sets/reps: `3x8..12 rpe 7`.
- Rest in seconds: `rest 90 seconds`.
